evaluations.detail: Capabilities use generic concepts ('paper_search', 'structured_extraction', etc.); provider product branding is stored strictly as profile metadata.
Evaluation, validation, and routing are pure deterministic TypeScript/JavaScript logic with injectable clocks and zero inference requirements.
Free and manual routes are prioritized; paid routes are blocked by default and cannot be activated through automatic fallback.
Integrates cleanly with existing CapabilityRegistry from local-router.mjs and economic policy patterns without duplicating infrastructure.
